_comment: Committed cron-job configuration for the FDI site monitors. Import into cron-job.org (https://cron-job.org/en/) or any compatible scheduler. Both jobs must be active for the silence monitor to work correctly.

_env.CRON_SECRET: Set in production secrets — the value from CRON_SECRET env var. Pass as Authorization: Bearer header.

jobs.title: FDI — external link check
jobs.description: Crawls the live site, probes all external URLs, emails the team if any are broken. Writes a row to cron_runs so the silence monitor knows the cron is healthy.
jobs.notes: The job spawns a child process and returns 202 immediately; crawl runs detached. Failures are advisory — the endpoint always returns 202 on auth success.

jobs.title: FDI — cron silence monitor
jobs.description: Independently checks whether the link-check job has recorded a run within the last 48 h. If not, and no silence alert has been sent in the last 24 h (cooldown persisted in cron_alerts Postgres table), emails WAITLIST_NOTIFY_EMAIL. Must run on its OWN schedule, separate from the link-check job — that independence is the whole point.
jobs.notes: Runs every 6 h so an alert fires within 6 h of a 48-h silence threshold being crossed. The spawned cron-silence-check.mjs script handles all threshold and cooldown logic with Postgres-persisted state — the endpoint itself is stateless.

required_production_env.DATABASE_URL: Postgres connection string — required for cron_runs and cron_alerts tables
required_production_env.CRON_SECRET: Shared secret that gates both /api/cron/* endpoints — must match what the scheduler sends
required_production_env.SITE_BASE_URL: Canonical production origin, e.g. https://falsedawn.industries — required for the link-check crawl
required_production_env.RESEND_FROM: Verified Resend sender address — required for silence alert and link-check failure emails
required_production_env.WAITLIST_NOTIFY_EMAIL: Team inbox that receives silence alerts and link-check failure digests
